items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And I did all of his work, all of it for years.

ctx.x: So Ronnie, did you fall into studio work or was it like I want to get in the studio scene?

Well it wasn’t a thing like I — well when I got married yeah, we settled down and actually I did work for my brother, my brother was doing some stuff. My brother didn’t use me first. Actually one of the first people I worked for was Pat Williams, who my brother and Pat were very close you know. And I started working for Pat. And then I called — the only phone call I ever made to try to get a gig, I called this guy, his name was Steve Carmen. He was — he used to do an act. He did a Harry Belafonte act, guitar and…
So you’d travel from one date to another in a particular day.
